About us

A hair care brand made in small batches

Haircare Italia makes hair oils, serums and masks in limited quantities, with few ingredients and clear instructions.

We care about method more than trends: saying what is inside, how to use it and when to stop. We are not hairdressers or dermatologists: with a sensitive scalp or sudden hair loss, ask a professional.

How we behave

1Clarity

Ingredients, use and precautions written so anyone can understand them.

2Caution

Patch test, small amounts, safety before results.

3Honesty

No promises we cannot keep and no invented effects.
